title: Carlos and His Cards
text:
Carlos has a set of flashcards for English. Each card has a picture on one side. On the other side, there is an English word. Carlos looks at the picture and says the word.

Today Carlos learns the word dog. The picture shows a small brown dog. He says dog three times. Then he puts the card in a box.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
What word does Carlos learn today?
Why does Carlos say the word three times?
How does Carlos probably feel when he learns a new word?

vocabulary.definition: a drawing or photo of a person or thing
a unit of language that has a meaning
a container with four sides, used to keep things

paragraph_translations: Carlos tiene un juego de tarjetas de estudio para inglés. Cada tarjeta tiene una imagen de un lado. En el otro lado hay una palabra en inglés. Carlos mira la imagen y dice la palabra.
Hoy Carlos aprende la palabra «dog». La imagen muestra un perro pequeño de color marrón. Él dice «dog» tres veces. Luego pone la tarjeta en una caja.
